lines.text: This puzzle uses a strange new symbol: a star.
lines.caption: This puzzle uses a strange new symbol: a star.

lines.text: Lots of kids stop one step too early here. Let's go all the way!
lines.caption: Lots of kids stop one step too early here. Let's go all the way!

lines.text: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's crack it together.
lines.caption: Hi, I'm Vantee! Let's crack it together.

lines.text: Here's the question. For numbers a and b, a star b means a plus b, over one plus a times b.
lines.caption: Here's the question. For numbers a and b, a star b means a plus b, over one plus a times b.

lines.text: Find the value of one over two, star one over three, then star one over four, then star one over five.
lines.caption: Find the value of one over two, star one over three, then star one over four, then star one over five.

lines.text: Here are the five choices. Take a good look.
lines.caption: Here are the five choices. Take a good look.

lines.text: So what are we really asked?
lines.caption: So what are we really asked?

lines.text: Star is a made-up rule. Put in two numbers, and out comes a new one.
lines.caption: Star is a made-up rule. Put in two numbers, and out comes a new one.

lines.text: The brackets say: begin inside, then star each answer with the next number.
lines.caption: The brackets say: begin inside, then star each answer with the next number.

lines.text: Now it's your turn. Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!
lines.caption: Now it's your turn. Pause the video and give it a go. I'll wait!

lines.text: Welcome back! Let's follow the rule, one step at a time.
lines.caption: Welcome back! Let's follow the rule, one step at a time.

lines.text: First, one over two, star one over three. We'll do the top and bottom separately.
lines.caption: First, one over two, star one over three. We'll do the top and bottom separately.

lines.text: Top: one over two plus one over three. That's five over six.
lines.caption: Top: one over two plus one over three. That's five over six.

lines.text: Bottom: one plus one over six. That's seven over six.
lines.caption: Bottom: one plus one over six. That's seven over six.

lines.text: Five over six, divided by seven over six. The sixes cancel. Five over seven!
lines.caption: Five over six, divided by seven over six. The sixes cancel. Five over seven!

lines.text: Step two: five over seven, star one over four.
lines.caption: Step two: five over seven, star one over four.

lines.text: Top: five over seven plus one over four is twenty-seven over twenty-eight.
lines.caption: Top: five over seven plus one over four is twenty-seven over twenty-eight.

lines.text: Bottom: one plus five over twenty-eight is thirty-three over twenty-eight.
lines.caption: Bottom: one plus five over twenty-eight is thirty-three over twenty-eight.

lines.text: So we get twenty-seven over thirty-three. Divide both by three. Nine over eleven!
lines.caption: So we get twenty-seven over thirty-three. Divide both by three. Nine over eleven!

lines.text: Last step: nine over eleven, star one over five.
lines.caption: Last step: nine over eleven, star one over five.

lines.text: Top: nine over eleven plus one over five is fifty-six over fifty-five.
lines.caption: Top: nine over eleven plus one over five is fifty-six over fifty-five.

lines.text: Bottom: one plus nine over fifty-five is sixty-four over fifty-five.
lines.caption: Bottom: one plus nine over fifty-five is sixty-four over fifty-five.

lines.text: So we get fifty-six over sixty-four. Divide both by eight.
lines.caption: So we get fifty-six over sixty-four. Divide both by eight.

lines.text: <short pause> That's seven over eight! The answer is C.
lines.caption: That's seven over eight! The answer is C.

lines.text: Here's a sneaky second way. Let's give each number a score.
lines.caption: Here's a sneaky second way. Let's give each number a score.

lines.text: The score is one plus the number, over one minus the number.
lines.caption: The score is one plus the number, over one minus the number.

lines.text: Take one over two. Its score is three over two, divided by one over two. That's three.
lines.caption: Take one over two. Its score is three over two, divided by one over two. That's three.

lines.text: And one over three scores two. Here's the magic: star two numbers, and their scores multiply!
lines.caption: And one over three scores two. Here's the magic: star two numbers, and their scores multiply!

lines.text: Let's test it. Our first step gave five over seven.
lines.caption: Let's test it. Our first step gave five over seven.

lines.text: Its score is twelve over seven, divided by two over seven. That's six. And three times two is six!
lines.caption: Its score is twelve over seven, divided by two over seven. That's six. And three times two is six!

lines.text: Why does it work? Add one to a star b: the top becomes one plus a, times one plus b. Multiply it out!
lines.caption: Why does it work? Add one to a star b: the top becomes one plus a, times one plus b. Multiply it out!

lines.text: Take a star b away from one. The top is one minus a, times one minus b. Divide: the bottoms cancel!
lines.caption: Take a star b away from one. The top is one minus a, times one minus b. Divide: the bottoms cancel!

lines.text: Each star multiplies the scores. So the score of the final answer is the four scores, multiplied.
lines.caption: Each star multiplies the scores. So the score of the final answer is the four scores, multiplied.

lines.text: Now our four scores: three over one, four over two, five over three, and six over four.
lines.caption: Now our four scores: three over one, four over two, five over three, and six over four.

lines.text: Multiply them, and almost everything cancels! Five times six, over two. That's fifteen.
lines.caption: Multiply them, and almost everything cancels! Five times six, over two. That's fifteen.

lines.text: So one plus the answer is fifteen times one minus the answer.
lines.caption: So one plus the answer is fifteen times one minus the answer.

lines.text: One plus the answer, plus one minus the answer, is always two.
lines.caption: One plus the answer, plus one minus the answer, is always two.

lines.text: That's fifteen parts plus one part, so sixteen parts make two. Each part is one over eight.
lines.caption: That's fifteen parts plus one part, so sixteen parts make two. Each part is one over eight.

lines.text: One minus the answer is one over eight. So the answer is seven over eight!
lines.caption: One minus the answer is one over eight. So the answer is seven over eight!

lines.text: When would you pick this way? When the chain is long, like ten stars in a row.
lines.caption: When would you pick this way? When the chain is long, like ten stars in a row.

lines.text: Now, let's look at the wrong answers. Each one is a trap.
lines.caption: Now, let's look at the wrong answers. Each one is a trap.

lines.text: Five over seven is only the first step. Two more stars are left!
lines.caption: Five over seven is only the first step. Two more stars are left!

lines.text: Nine over eleven comes after two steps. There's still one more to go.
lines.caption: Nine over eleven comes after two steps. There's still one more to go.

lines.text: Seventy-seven over sixty just adds the four fractions. It forgets the bottom of the rule.
lines.caption: Seventy-seven over sixty just adds the four fractions. It forgets the bottom of the rule.

lines.text: Use the star on two numbers between zero and one, and the result stays below one. So it's too big!
lines.caption: Use the star on two numbers between zero and one, and the result stays below one. So it's too big!

lines.text: Fourteen over fifteen is what you'd get if you just did one minus one over fifteen.
lines.caption: Fourteen over fifteen is what you'd get if you just did one minus one over fifteen.

lines.text: But fifteen is the score, not the answer. You still have to turn it back.
lines.caption: But fifteen is the score, not the answer. You still have to turn it back.

lines.text: Ready for a challenge? Same star rule, new numbers.
lines.caption: Ready for a challenge? Same star rule, new numbers.

lines.text: Start with one over three, star one over four. Then star one over five, then star one over six.
lines.caption: Start with one over three, star one over four. Then star one over five, then star one over six.

lines.text: Pause the video, and go for it!
lines.caption: Pause the video, and go for it!

lines.text: Let's check. One over three, star one over four, is seven over thirteen.
lines.caption: Let's check. One over three, star one over four, is seven over thirteen.

lines.text: Seven over thirteen, star one over five, is two over three.
lines.caption: Seven over thirteen, star one over five, is two over three.

lines.text: Two over three, star one over six, is three over four!
lines.caption: Two over three, star one over six, is three over four!

lines.text: Our four scores are four over two, five over three, six over four, and seven over five. They multiply to seven.
lines.caption: Our four scores are four over two, five over three, six over four, and seven over five. They multiply to seven.

lines.text: So one plus the answer is seven times one minus the answer.
lines.caption: So one plus the answer is seven times one minus the answer.

lines.text: Seven plus one is eight parts. Eight parts make two, so each is one over four. Three over four again!
lines.caption: Seven plus one is eight parts. Eight parts make two, so each is one over four. Three over four again!

lines.text: If you found three over four, amazing work!
lines.caption: If you found three over four, amazing work!

lines.text: Here's the big idea to remember.
lines.caption: Here's the big idea to remember.

lines.text: With a made-up rule, follow it exactly: one step at a time, top and bottom separately.
lines.caption: With a made-up rule, follow it exactly: one step at a time, top and bottom separately.

lines.text: And go all the way to the last step. Stopping early is the trap!
lines.caption: And go all the way to the last step. Stopping early is the trap!

lines.text: I'm Vantee. Keep exploring, and I'll see you next time!
lines.caption: I'm Vantee. Keep exploring, and I'll see you next time!
